You know, {01 00 00 0f 00}I'm not really
into huge megastores.

{07 0e 00}Small stores may have less
to choose from,{01 00 00 05 00} but the 
styles are way more fresh.{01 00 00 05 00}

how you think about it,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
